Its fine craftsmanship is sturdy enough to withstand backbreaking fieldwork, but its battle applications are untested.|Allies|AoC}} ==Location and Uses== ==={{BotW|-}}=== {{BotW Item Properties/Store |type = Weapon |strength = 16 |durability = 6 |flammable = No |magnetic = Yes |buoyant = No |conductive = Yes |guardian = No |throw = Yes |throw_effect = }} {{Compendium/Extract|Farming Hoe}} Farming Hoes are a tool used by farmers to till their fields, and as a result are found near [[Hylian]] settlements and ruins in [[East Necluda]] and [[Hyrule Field]]. Regular [[Bokoblin]]s may also wield them as [[Weapon]]s. They can be used as two-handed Weapons by [[Link]], though their application in battle is untested. Farming Hoes belong to the [[Daily Use Goods]] equipment archetype, which is a series of tools that double as Weapons for Link.{{Cite Book|quote= |book= CaC |publisher= |page= 169}} Due to their metallic components, Farming Hoes will attract [[Lightning]] if they are equipped during [[Thunderstorm]]s and conduct [[Electricity]]. This also makes them magnetic, which means they can be picked up using the [[Magnesis]] [[Rune]]. They sink if they are dropped in the [[Water (Terrain)|Water]], but they will not burn if exposed to [[Fire]] or a [[Scorching Climate]]. {{BotW Weapon Parameters |ActorName = "Weapon_Lsword_045" |Life = 6 |Power = 16 |SpHitActor = "" |SpHitRatio = 2.0 |IsHammer = false |IsWeakBreaker = false |IsBoomerang = false |IsLuckyWeapon = false |IsPikohan = false |IsThrowingWeapon = true |IsThrowingBreakWeapon = true |ThrowRange = 5.0 |ChemicalEnergyMax = 0 |ChemicalEnergyAmountUsed = 0 |ChemicalEnergyRecoverRate = 0.0 |ChemicalEnergyRecoverInterval = 60 |ShootBeam = "" |SharpWeaponAddAtkMin = 8 |SharpWeaponAddAtkMax = 14 |SharpWeaponAddLifeMin = 1 |SharpWeaponAddLifeMax = 2 |SharpWeaponAddCrit = true |PoweredSharpAddAtkMin = 15 |PoweredSharpAddAtkMax = 20 |PoweredSharpAddLifeMin = 3 |PoweredSharpAddLifeMax = 3 |PoweredSharpAddThrowMin = 1.5 |PoweredSharpAddThrowMax = 2.0 |ThrowSpeed = 0.7 |ThrowRotSpeed = 50.0 |SellingPrice = 1 |BuyingPrice = 3 }} ==={{TotK|-}}=== {{Compendium/Extract/TotK|Farming Hoe}} {{Stub|TotK}} ==Other Appearances== ==={{AoC|-}}=== {{Noncanon|Start}} {{AoC Item Properties/Store |type= Link Two-Handed Weapon }} {{Stub|AoC}} {{Noncanon|End}} ==Nomenclature== {{Nomenclature}} ==Gallery== {{All Images}} File:AoC Farming Hoe Icon.png|{{Game Label|{{AoC|-}}}}Icon for the Farming Hoe ==See Also== {{See Also| * Daily Use Goods * Farmer's Pitchfork * Farm Tool * Weapon }} {{Ref}} {{Categories |Daily Use Goods, Two-Handed Weapons, Weapons |items= BotW, TotK, AoC }}
